title: dispatch-plan — the dispatcher's playbook for plans in the backlog
description: Use this when the user asks for a plan, or a backlog plan-item already covers the area; otherwise the dispatcher stays in dispatch-direct. The dispatcher's playbook for plans, which live in the backlog: product-manager prioritizes, architect returns the structured items with their part_of / blocks edges, the dispatcher has backlog-operator file and link them, and it executes from the ready view. The dispatcher never designs the plan structure and never touches the graph. Load when a plan is named or discovered; otherwise stay in dispatch-direct.
author: sox
